clips.title: The story
paras: Wildbend River is a tainted waterway winding through the southern forests of Darkshore near the Grove of the Ancients. Flowing down directly from the corrupted heights of Felwood, its waters carry demonic poison toward the sea, endangering the surrounding wilderness.

Wildbend River cuts through the southern reaches of Darkshore, flowing westward past the sacred Grove of the Ancients before emptying into the sea. Rather than offering clean nourishment to the woodland, it brings corruption down from the mountains. The river is the direct continuation of Felwood's Bloodvenom River, tumbling through the rocky ridges and dragging foul, corrupted runoff into Darkshore's ecosystem. The night elves monitor its banks closely, watching for twisted wildlife and the creeping spread of demonic blight.
